label: preparing
what: A hospitality committee was preparing bread for an evening gathering in the great hall; the innkeeper says it was reserved for the meeting. Baker baked the bread, but the record does not establish the baker knowingly helped the committee or knew its purpose. Mayor was told of the appointment and bread deliveries in general, but not told the committee's identity/purpose before the event; the record supports preparations undisclosed to the mayor in that specific sense, not that the mayor knew nothing about the gathering.
